description: Les horaires des navires de la sonotrak pendant toute l'année (hors été) is a data set listed in Tunisian transport sector open data portal (data.transport.tn), a sector open data portal, published or maintained by Société Nouvelle de Transport Kerkennah SONOTRAK. les horaires de départs des voyages des navires du transport de passagers, de marchandises, de voitures, de camions et tout autre type de matériel roulant entre Sfax et l’archipel de Kerkennah dans les deux sens pendant toute l'année (hors été). Coverage: Tunisia. The portal files it under the publisher Société Nouvelle de Transport Kerkennah SONOTRAK. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-01-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is OTL (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tunisia-transport-open-data-portal.
